title: Ridge / gradient-boosting experiment - pre-registered protocol
written: 2026-10-27, after the Phase 1 audit (development data only, reports/audit.json) and before any candidate was fitted
disclosure: January 2026 is not untouched: the production defaults were chosen partly on January evidence, earlier experiments scored their winners on January, and the author has seen January diagnostics (including the 3 Jan 2026 investigation). January is used here as the designated test period: read once, after selection, and never for tuning or choosing.

data.source: backend/ml/processed/ml_dataset.csv (read only), built from the Elexon files already in the project: DATASETS/*_Actual.json (FUELHH wind) and DATASETS1/*_Forecast.json (WINDFOR). No downloads, no other providers.
data.development: splits 'train' + 'validation': deliveries 2025-10-02 .. 2025-12-31 (decisions before January). The only rows used to fit, tune and choose.
data.test: split 'test': January 2026 decisions, deliveries 2026-01-02 .. 2026-02-01 (744 h). Read once, after reports/selection.json is written.
data.february_2026: not used (it was used to choose the production defaults)

decision_rule: forecast_mw = latest WINDFOR value published at or before 09:50 Europe/London on D-1; every feature uses only data published by that cutoff (production feature_builder)

targets.regression: error_mw = forecast_mw - actual_mw; corrected forecast = forecast_mw - predicted error

features.all: the 9 production features: forecast_mw, lead_hours, hour_uk, forecast_revision_mw, forecast_spread_mw, forecast_ramp_mw, forecast_day_mean_mw, latest_actual_mw, recent_error_mw
features.linear_models: hour_uk as sin/cos on a 24 h circle; other features: median imputation fitted on the training rows, then standardised
features.tree_models: the 9 features as they are (missing values handled natively)

validation.folds: 8 weekly chronological blocks, 2025-11-06 .. 2025-12-31 (the existing-data experiment's folds)
validation.training_window: expanding: every development delivery up to 2 days before the fold starts (labels of later days are not complete at the first cutoff of the fold)

ridge_all.role: regularised linear model on all 9 features

gbm_all.role: HistGradientBoostingRegressor on all 9 features, max_iter 200, l2_regularization 1.0, no early stopping, random_state 42

random_forest.role: existing comparison model: production specification and artifact, not tuned

logistic_all.role: L2-regularised logistic regression (the classification analogue of Ridge) on all 9 features, max_iter 2000

gbm_all.role: HistGradientBoostingClassifier on all 9 features, max_iter 200, l2_regularization 1.0, no early stopping, random_state 42

random_forest.role: existing comparison model: production specification and artifact, not tuned

candidates.grid_order: each grid is listed simplest / most regularised first; ties go to the earlier configuration

selection.regression: within each family: lowest pooled out-of-fold MAE
selection.classification: within each family: lowest pooled out-of-fold Brier score
selection.january: never used for selection or tuning

final_models: each selected configuration refitted once on all development deliveries; linear_by_level, logistic_by_level and both random forests are the production artifacts (unchanged), checked against a refit where the specification is deterministic

january_evaluation.over_correction: mean corrected error (corrected - actual) in a segment; negative = over-corrected; plus the share of hours with corrected below actual
residuals: mean corrected error by forecast band
slope of corrected error on forecast_mw
share of corrected-error variance that is a whole-day offset

statistics: 3-day circular block bootstrap over delivery days, seed 42: 5000 resamples (2000 for ROC-AUC); 95% percentile intervals of baseline minus candidate

decision_rule_for_production.regression: a candidate is 'supported' only if (a) its pooled CV MAE is below the production baseline's and (b) the 95% interval of January MAE(baseline) - MAE(candidate) lies entirely above 0
decision_rule_for_production.classification: a candidate is 'supported' only if (a) its pooled CV Brier is below the production logistic model's and (b) the 95% interval of January Brier(baseline) - Brier(candidate) lies entirely above 0
decision_rule_for_production.even_if_supported: report for approval only; no production change without the user's decision. Three regression and three classification candidates are compared without a multiplicity correction, so borderline results are not treated as evidence.
